Mira: Heads-up — queue depth for mosaic-8b in eu-west1 climbed past 2k about 12m ago, still trending up. p99 lat +3x.
infra-bot: Alert: model_queue_depth > 1500 (mosaic-8b / eu-west1) at 2025-05-02T14:02:24Z
Jonathan: Is this sudden burst or gradual backlog?
Mira: Started as a burst ~15m, then sustained. GPU utilization on the shard group is 96%, KV cache hitrates dropped.
Ashok: Any regional infra issues (network, disk)?
Mira: No network errors, disk I/O nominal. Looks like pure compute saturation.
Tess: Which callers? I see partner-internal X sending large batch evals, plus organic hosted traffic. Non-dedicated.
Mira: Correct — partner X spiked evals (long contexts) + an onboarding test ramp. Combined got us.
Jonathan: Quick mitigation ideas: 1) engage fairshare to throttle non-SLA tenants; 2) enable model fallback to mosaic-4b for best-effort requests; 3) temporary spillover to other regions. Thoughts?
Ashok: Spillover to us-west adds cross-region egress cost and latency. Prefer local mitigation first.
Tess: We can flip a per-tenant rate cap for hosted_free and hosted_trial to 30% of normal. That should free slots quickly.
Mira: Agreed. Also bump prefix cache TTLs for common prompts to reduce token work.
Jonathan: I'll run a quick check on queue distribution.
deploy-bot: rtrctl job queued: run check-queue-distribution (id d-8743)
Jonathan: Output: ```
$ rtrctl queue show --model=mosaic-8b --region=eu-west1
shard-1: depth=780 (active), GPUs=8/8 util=98%
shard-2: depth=610 (active), GPUs=8/8 util=95%
shard-3: depth=640 (active), GPUs=8/8 util=96%
spillable: 0 (no eligible secondary region configured)
```
Tess: OK. If we enforce hosted_trial=0.3 rps and enable fallback routing, we should drop queue by ~45% in 10m based on sim.
Ashok: What's the cost hit if we route 30% to us-west mosaic-4b? Estimated cross-region egress + extra GPU cycles?
Mira: Quick back-of-envelope: ~0.6k/day assuming current token mix. Better than p99 latency outages.
Jonathan: Proposed immediate runbook: 
- Mira: increase hosted_trial admission multiplier -> 0.3 (now)
- Tess: enable model_fallback policy for mosaic-8b -> mosaic-4b (best-effort)
- Ashok: open temporary partner X rate review; offer dedicated trial if they need sustained capacity
- Jonathan: monitor queue depth & p99 every 3m; rollback if error rates increase
Tess: I'll patch the policy now, Mir a can you confirm metrics after 10m?
Mira: On it. Pushing change.
infra-bot: Policy change: admission_multiplier hosted_trial set to 0.3 by Tess at 2025-05-02T14:05:12Z
Mira: After 8m: queue depth down ~48%, p99 latency back to baseline-ish. Fallback ramped to 4b for ~28% of routed traffic.
Ashok: Good. Follow-ups: add spillable tag to eu-west1 shard-pool so we can auto-fallback next time without manual routing; estimate cost impact and propose threshold for automatic cross-region spill in runbook.
Jonathan: I'll open a ticket to track partner X usage + dedicated upsell.
Tess: I'll add a short-term dashboard tile for fairshare headroom per region.
Mira: Leaving this thread open for 24h. If things stay stable we'll revert gradual limits in 12h.
Jonathan: Thanks all :thumbsup:
